Hey there! Great job getting into Warrior I pose. Let's make a few adjustments to help you find more alignment and strength in this powerful stance.

I notice your spine isn't quite straight right now. Think about lengthening your spine, drawing your shoulders back, and creating a nice, tall line from your tailbone to the crown of your head. Imagine a string pulling you up from the top of your head, helping you elongate.

Your arms could also be more fully extended. Try reaching them straight up overhead, palms facing each other, and really stretch through your fingertips. Engage your arms and feel the energy extending upward.

Lastly, let's check your knee alignment. In Warrior I, you want your front knee to be directly over your ankle, not pushing forward past your toes. This helps protect your knee joint and creates a strong, stable foundation.

These are small adjustments that can make a big difference in your pose. Don't worry about being perfect - yoga is a practice, and every time you come to the mat, you're getting stronger and more aligned. Keep breathing, stay focused, and make these adjustments mindfully. You're doing great!

Would you like me to demonstrate these alignment points for you?
